task: civora-org/civora-platform#125: CRZ round-trip — confirm the filing and link the official record

commits.subject: feat(crz-filing): confirm the CRZ filing and link the official record (civora-org/civora-platform#125)
commits.author: Denys Kozlov

logicalChanges.reason: civora-platform#125: store the verified CRZ filing confirmation (filed_at, published_on, override reason) as nullable system columns.
logicalChanges.expectedBehavior: Additive reversible migration, no backfill, no defaults/indexes.

logicalChanges.entity: Admin::ConfirmCrzFiling command, FilingLookup, FilingComparison, Mapper/CrzScope extensions
logicalChanges.reason: Verify a hand-filed editorial contract against the official CRZ record and stamp the filing under the row lock, with mirror absorption.
logicalChanges.expectedBehavior: Fetch outside lock; in-lock re-check of source/state/filed/checksum/comparison/reason/id; one transaction with audit row; refusals broadcast as symbols.
alternatives: Audit absorbed-mirror row targeting the destroyed mirror (rejected: dangling target)

logicalChanges.entity: Sync linked rule, G4 fix, deadline hard switch
logicalChanges.reason: A filing-confirmed editorial record is the canonical linked record of its CRZ id; sync must not duplicate or flag it. Failure stamps must never touch editorial rows. Deadline tracking keys on crz_filed_at.
logicalChanges.expectedBehavior: :linked outcome with zero writes at all decision points; linked counters; find_mirror/mark_failed scoped to source crz; tracked? uses crz_filed_at.

logicalChanges.entity: Admin filing UI, permission, routes, public detail, locales, audit labels, docs
logicalChanges.reason: Editor-facing round trip: preview comparison page, confirm POST, index entry link, public CRZ publication line.
logicalChanges.expectedBehavior: GET preview writes nothing; POST runs the command; en/sk parity; editor-only permission on published unfiled editorial records.
